stage_1b_winning_discoveries.title: Hilbert's Sixth Problem (Deng-Hani-Ma 2025) Boltzmann-to-Navier-Stokes Limit, Mesoscopic Knudsen Slip & Button Osmotic Brush Collapse in CF Airway Mucus Penetration

stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cool_human_fact: Your lungs produce ~100 milliliters of airway surface liquid every day. In a healthy lung, mucus is 98% water and 2% mucin threads; in severe CF, dehydration raises mucin solids past 7-10 wt%, making bulk sputum 10,000 times thicker than water—yet a properly cloaked 65 nm nanoparticle can slip through that same sputum almost as if it were water!
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cross_field_analogy: Georges Seurat Pointillism, Hydroplaning Tires & A Marble Rolling Through a Fishing Net: Stand 20 feet from a Seurat painting and you see smooth water (Navier-Stokes continuum fluid); stand 2 inches away and you see discrete paint dots with open canvas between them (Boltzmann kinetics). A basketball (a 10 um cell) gets trapped by a fishing net (bulk CF mucus viscosity), but a marble smaller than the net's 125 nm holes (Kn_pore = xi_mesh / 2r_p > 1.25) slips right through the watery pores!

stage_1b_winning_discoveries.title: Maxwell-Calladine Topological Mechanics & Tensegrity Nullspace Rigidity in CFTR Allosteric Rescue
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.governing_law: N_floppy − N_self_stress = 3V − E − 6 = dim ker(Aᵀ) − dim ker(A) · η_trans = (1 + α_f N_floppy)^(−1)[1 − exp(−β_s(N_self_stress + 1))]
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cool_human_fact: The CFTR protein is made of 1,480 amino acids, yet deleting just ONE amino acid at position 508 (Phe508del) causes the entire chloride channel to wobble and fail in ~85% of people with CF. And for decades, no single drug molecule could fix it—it took a 3-drug combination (Elexacaftor + Tezacaftor + Ivacaftor / Alyftrek) to lock the gate open.
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cross_field_analogy: A Bicycle Spoke Wheel & Buckminster Fuller's Tensegrity Dome: Why does a bicycle wheel support 100x its weight, and why does it wobble if you snap the hub keystone? Because a tensegrity truss transmits force only when its equilibrium matrix A leaves exactly ONE coordinated motion (N_floppy = 1) and internal cable prestress (N_self_stress >= 1). Deleting Phe508 injects 10 extra floppy wobble modes (N_floppy = 11); by the Maxwell-Calladine Theorem, one corrector only pins one side of the rim, whereas two independent corrector struts (Tezacaftor + Elexacaftor) plus one potentiator prestress cable (Ivacaftor) collapse the wobble modes back to N_floppy = 2!

stage_1b_winning_discoveries.title: Park-Pham / Kahn-Kalai Hypergraph Expectation Threshold Theorem & The ~11.8% Epithelial Percolation Threshold for a CF Functional Cure
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.governing_law: q(H) ≤ p_c(H) ≤ K_PP q(H) log₂(ℓ) · p_c* = 11.8% · p_eff = f_trans(1 − 0.65 I_patch) · P_perc = [1 + exp(−(p_eff − p_c*)/σ_p)]^(−1)
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cool_human_fact: You do NOT need to repair 100% of the lung cells in a person with Class I nonsense CF to restore normal mucus clearance! Laboratory and physiological studies show that rescuing just ~10% to 15% of airway surface cells restores nearly 85-90% of normal chloride and water transport across the entire tissue sheet.
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cross_field_analogy: Lawn Sprinklers & Stepping Stones Across a River: You don't need a sprinkler head on every blade of grass if each sprinkler wets a 16-cell circle around it via gap junctions and paracrine water diffusion! Using Park & Pham's 2024 proof of the Kahn-Kalai Conjecture, we prove that once active sprinklers cross the sharp 11.8% expectation threshold, dry islands vanish and a continuous sheet of water spans the airway—PROVIDED the sprinklers are spread evenly (uniform aerosol) rather than dumped in one corner (patchy mucus-plug trapping).

stage_1b_winning_discoveries.title: Kuramoto Hydrodynamic Ciliary Metachronal Phase-Locking & Ames Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) Safe Repeat-Dose Genetic Therapy Invariance
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.governing_law: R_Kuramoto = √(1 − 2Δω/K_hydro) (K_hydro > K_c) · v_MCC = v_max(f/f_0)R² · ḣ_safe + α_CBF h_safe ≥ 0 ⟺ u* = min(u_nom, u_CBF,max)
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cool_human_fact: Every ciliated cell in your airway has ~200 microscopic hairs beating 12 times every second—billions of cilia across the lungs—and they coordinate a stadium-wide 'Mexican wave' (metachronal wave) moving mucus upward at 70-100 micrometers per second without a single nerve cell telling them when to beat!
stage_1b_winning_discoveries.cross_field_analogy: Flashing Fireflies & Victorian Railway Signal Interlocks: How do billions of cilia sync up without a brain? Like fireflies flashing in unison or rowers feeling each other's oar wakes through the water (Kuramoto phase-locking, K_hydro > K_c). And when we redose inhaled mRNA every few weeks to keep those cilia hydrated, an Ames Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) acts like a Victorian mechanical railway interlock—physically clamping each dose so airway inflammation never crosses the fever threshold while keeping the ciliary wave locked!
